<!-- 这将影响哪些组件？ -->

- [ ] **存储 (Storage)** (TimescaleDB / CAGGs / Schema)
- [ ] **可视化 (Visualization)** (Grafana Dashboards / Panels)
- [ ] **警报 (Alerting)** (Prometheus / Alertmanager Rules)
